ejs_confirmation.method: Original six and predeclared confirmation twenty pairs are retained separately and combined as 26 independent paired ratios, using the unchanged 10000-resample percentile bootstrap. A/A remains separate. No normalization, subtraction, or retrospective noise threshold.

limits: Primary proof timings use the standalone frozen proof artifact, not the combined array+proof main integration.
Array and CLDR stage gains are not multiplied into a claimed cumulative speedup.
Fresh non-reflink matched copies were hashed and filefrag metadata recorded, but some extents remained delalloc/unknown_loc; settled physical allocation was not established.
Native ARM64 Linux only; no new x86-64 or wasm32 execution.
No repeated-until-pass sampling, A/A subtraction, or new noise threshold.
The direct cumulative startup comparison excludes the array-pair candidate.
No full CLDR generator re-fetch/regeneration performed for this proof change.
